title: IVF + PQ 量化误差：量化前后距离误差与召回损失
expected_output:
IVF+PQ 量化平均距离误差 = 2.47
暴力Top5 = [np.int64(23), np.int64(45), np.int64(68), np.int64(75), np.int64(143)]
量化Top5 = [np.int64(5), np.int64(8), np.int64(10), np.int64(11), np.int64(25)]
召回重合数 = 0
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
N, D = 200, 8
data = rng.standard_normal((N, D))
q = rng.standard_normal(D)
n_clusters = 4

centroids = data[rng.choice(N, n_clusters, replace=False)].copy()
for _ in range(10):
    dists = np.linalg.norm(data[:, None, :] - centroids[None, :, :], axis=2)
    assign = np.argmin(dists, axis=1)
    centroids = np.array([
        data[assign == c].mean(axis=0) if np.any(assign == c) else centroids[c]
        for c in range(n_clusters)
    ])

M = 2
seg = D // M
assign = np.argmin(
    np.linalg.norm(data[:, None, :] - centroids[None, :, :], axis=2), axis=1)
pq_cent = []
for m in range(M):
    seg_data = data[:, m * seg:(m + 1) * seg]
    c = seg_data[rng.choice(N, 2, replace=False)]
    for _ in range(5):
        dd = np.linalg.norm(seg_data[:, None, :] - c[None, :, :], axis=2)
        a = np.argmin(dd, axis=1)
        c = np.array([
            seg_data[a == j].mean(axis=0) if np.any(a == j) else c[j]
            for j in range(2)
        ])
    pq_cent.append(c)

recon = np.zeros((N, D))
for i in range(N):
    base = centroids[assign[i]].copy()
    for m in range(M):
        seg_vec = data[i, m * seg:(m + 1) * seg]
        j = np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(seg_vec - pq_cent[m], axis=1))
        base[m * seg:(m + 1) * seg] = pq_cent[m][j]
    recon[i] = base

err = np.linalg.norm(data - recon, axis=1)
print('IVF+PQ 量化平均距离误差 =', round(float(err.mean()), 4))
true_d = np.linalg.norm(data - q, axis=1)
quant_d = np.linalg.norm(recon - q, axis=1)
true_top = set(np.argsort(true_d)[:5])
quant_top = set(np.argsort(quant_d)[:5])
print('暴力Top5 =', sorted(true_top))
print('量化Top5 =', sorted(quant_top))
print('召回重合数 =', len(true_top & quant_top))
